text: Built a sales dashboard. Wrote SQL queries joining orders and customers tables in PostgreSQL.
Ran a regression on survey data and reported confidence intervals for the mean.
Implemented a settings parser module with unit tests in pytest covering error cases.
Took a full backup of a training database, restored it after deleting a table, and reviewed user permissions.
Designed a responsive web interface in React with HTML and CSS for the club site.
Mapped the as-is workflow with stakeholders and documented three use cases.
Wrote user stories and acceptance criteria for the booking feature.
Prepared the project plan with milestones and a Gantt schedule for the capstone.
Scanned a lab network for vulnerabilities and configured the firewall rules.
Used an LLM with careful prompting to draft test data, then verified it by hand.
Organised the volunteer schedule for the charity fair.
Wrote SQL queries for the report and unit tests for the export function.
